claim_text: Low use of iodized salt and low intake of animal-source foods may warrant review of iodine sources, but total intake also depends on fortified foods, seaweed and local food policy; neither deficiency nor need for supplementation can be inferred from those two answers alone.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported or duplicate supplementation and support context-specific assessment.

population.other_context: People reporting little iodized salt and few animal-source foods.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify product label and composition.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iodine Health Professional Fact Sheet describes dietary sources, deficiency and excess risks.
limitations: Seaweed iodine content is highly variable; thyroid conditions and medicines require additional review.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
